# Is your sitemap's <lastmod> telling the truth?

> Paste a sitemap.xml and check its lastmod dates for the freshness-faking patterns Google warns about: bad formats, future dates and uniform dates. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
